listing.title: IBhayibheli Elingcwele
listing.shortDescription: IBhayibheli Elingcwele · I-KJV · Lalela isahluko · Izinhlelo zokufunda
listing.fullDescription:
Funda, lalela futhi uqonde iBhayibheli Elingcwele — mahhala, futhi eliklanywe kahle njengeBhayibheli langempela eliyiphepha.

📖 IZINGUQUKO ZEBHAYIBHELI AMANINGI
• King James Version (KJV) — eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, isebenza ngokugcwele ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
• I-World English Bible (WEB) — yesimanje, isiNgisi esifundeka kalula
• Inguqulo ye-American Standard (ASV) — yakudala, ukunemba kwegama negama
• Bible in Basic English (BBE) — IsiNgisi esilula, esilungele abafundi abasha kanye nabafundi besiNgisi
• Shintsha izinguqulo ngokushesha kunoma yiliphi ikhasi; izinguqulo ozivulayo zigcinelwa ukufundwa ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi
• Zonke izincwadi ezingama-66 zeTestamente Elidala neLisha
• Gqamisa amavesi ngemibala emi-4, ibhukhimakhi futhi wabelane
• Usayizi wombhalo olungisekayo, imodi yemini nobusuku (emnyama).

🎧 IBHAYIBHELI LOKULALELA
• Lalela noma yisiphi isahluko esifundwa ngokuzwakalayo
• Khetha umxoxi wakho: Okwakudala, Okujulile, Omnene, Umxoxi wezindaba nokunye
• Isivinini sokufunda esilungisekayo

✨ BUZA IBHAYIBHELI (AI)
• Buza noma yimuphi umbuzo: "Usho ukuthini uJeremiya 29:11?"
• Izincazelo zamavesi, izincwadi nabalingiswa beBhayibheli
• Yonke impendulo icaphuna umBhalo wangempela onezinkomba
• Usizo lokukhathazeka, ukwesaba, usizi, intethelelo, umshado nokunye

🎤 UMLOBI WEZINSHUMAYELO
• Dala izintshumayelo ezigcwele nezinhlaka zokufunda iBhayibheli ngemizuzwana
• Izitayela zesihloko, ezichazayo noma zokuvangela
• Imifanekiso, isicelo, imibuzo yomthandazo kanye nengxoxo

📅 IZINHLELO ZOKUFUNDA IBHAYIBHELI
• Amapulani angu-34: IBhayibheli Ngonyaka, iTestamente Elisha ngezinsuku ezingu-90, amaHubo, iZaga, iVangeli likaJohane nezihloko ezinjengokuthula, ithemba nomthandazo
• Dala uhlelo lwakho lokufunda
• Landelela inqubekelaphambili futhi ugcine ukulandelana kwakho kwansuku zonke

🔔 IVESI LOSUKU NESIKHUMBUZO SAMALANGA
• Ivesi elisha leBhayibheli nsuku zonke
• Isikhumbuzo esimnene sansuku zonke sokufunda iZwi likaNkulunkulu
Ilungele ukuzinikela kwansuku zonke, ukutadisha iBhayibheli, isonto, umthandazo kanye nokulungiselela izintshumayelo. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umusha okholweni noma usufunde imiBhalo iminyaka, lolu hlelo lokusebenza lweBhayibheli Elingcwele lukusiza ukuba ukhule eduze noNkulunkulu nsuku zonke.

Landa uhlelo lokusebenza lwamahhala lweBhayibheli Elingcwele manje futhi uqale ukufunda namuhla!
listing.releaseNotes:
Yini entsha:
• Idizayini entsha yesikhumba kanye nemodi emnyama
• Amazwi alalelwayo eBhayibheli ngokwezifiso nesivinini sokudlala
• Izikhumbuzi zansuku zonke nokufunda-uhlelo lokulandelana
• Buza imibuzo noma cindezela Chaza ukuze uthole ukuqonda kwamavesi
• Azikho izikhangiso ngesikhathi sokufunda noma somsindo
• Ukuthinta komzimba okuthuthukisiwe nokusekelwa okusuka emaphethelweni kuya komphetho
• Ukusebenza okusheshayo, okuzinzile
